chats.zh-CN: 对话列表，受控使用，配合 `onChatsChange` 回写。只有整体替换数组才视为变化，就地修改同一数组不会更新界面。
chats.en-US: The conversation list, controlled; write changes back through `onChatsChange`. Only replacing the whole array counts as a change; mutating the same array in place does not update the view.

align.zh-CN: 对话布局方式，可选 `leftRight`（左右分布）或 `leftAlign`（左对齐）。

roleConfig.zh-CN: 角色信息，键为消息的 role。`avatar` 是图片 URL，其他头像内容使用 `chatBoxRenderConfig.renderRoleAvatar` 渲染。`color` 传给 Avatar。
roleConfig.en-US: Role information, keyed by the message role. `avatar` is an image URL; other avatar content goes through `chatBoxRenderConfig.renderRoleAvatar`. `color` is passed to Avatar.

hints.zh-CN: 提示信息列表。点击某项后，该项作为新的用户消息加入对话，并触发 `onHintClick`。
hints.en-US: The list of hints. Clicking one adds it to the conversation as a new user message and calls `onHintClick`.

sendHotKey.zh-CN: 发送快捷键，可选 `enter` 或 `shift+enter`。`enter` 时单独按 Enter 发送，Shift + Enter 换行；`shift+enter` 相反。
sendHotKey.en-US: Send hot key: `enter` or `shift+enter`. With `enter`, Enter sends and Shift + Enter inserts a line break; `shift+enter` is the reverse.

showStopGenerate.zh-CN: 是否在最后一条消息生成中时显示停止生成按钮。生成中发送按钮不可用，点击停止按钮触发 `onStopGenerator`。
showStopGenerate.en-US: Whether to show the stop button while the last message is generating. Sending is disabled meanwhile, and clicking the stop button calls `onStopGenerator`.

showClearContext.zh-CN: 是否在输入框中显示清除上下文按钮。
showClearContext.en-US: Whether to show the clear context button in the input box.

enableUpload.zh-CN: 是否启用上传。布尔值同时控制粘贴、点击和拖拽上传；传对象时分别设置 `pasteUpload`、`clickUpload`、`dragUpload`，未设置的项为 `true`。
enableUpload.en-US: Whether uploading is enabled. A boolean controls paste, click and drag upload together; an object sets `pasteUpload`, `clickUpload` and `dragUpload` separately, and unset items are `true`.

canSend.zh-CN: 发送按钮是否可用。通常由内部逻辑决定，设置后以此值为准。
canSend.en-US: Whether the send button is usable. The component normally decides this itself; a given value takes precedence.

escapeHtml.zh-CN: 是否转义用户消息中的 HTML 标签，防止被 Markdown 解析器当作 HTML 处理导致内容丢失。
escapeHtml.en-US: Whether to escape HTML tags in user messages, so the Markdown parser does not treat them as HTML and drop their content.

uploadProps.zh-CN: 传给 Upload 的属性。`fileList` 与 `defaultFileList` 由 Chat 管理，`onChange` 由 Chat 处理，不会传给 Upload；`children` 作为上传按钮的自定义触发元素。
uploadProps.en-US: Props passed to Upload. Chat manages `fileList` and `defaultFileList`, and handles `onChange` itself, so it is not passed to Upload; `children` replaces the upload button as its trigger.

uploadTipProps.zh-CN: 上传按钮提示 Tooltip 的属性，`content` 为提示文字。
uploadTipProps.en-US: Props of the upload button's Tooltip; `content` is the tip text.

markdownRenderProps.zh-CN: 传给消息内容所用 MarkdownRender 的属性，默认 `format` 为 `md`。`raw` 与 `components` 由 Chat 设置，自定义渲染组件使用 `customMarkDownComponents`。
markdownRenderProps.en-US: Props passed to the MarkdownRender that renders message content; `format` defaults to `md`. Chat sets `raw` and `components` itself; use `customMarkDownComponents` for custom renderers.

customMarkDownComponents.zh-CN: 自定义 Markdown 渲染组件，键为元素名，透传给消息内容的 MarkdownRender。
customMarkDownComponents.en-US: Custom Markdown renderers keyed by element name, passed to the MarkdownRender of message content.

inputBoxCls.en-US: Class name of the input box.

hintCls.en-US: Class name of the outermost element of the hint area.

hintStyle.en-US: Style of the outermost element of the hint area.

chatBoxRenderConfig.zh-CN: 消息框各部分的自定义渲染函数，类型见 `ChatBoxRenderConfig`。
chatBoxRenderConfig.en-US: Custom render functions for parts of the message box; see `ChatBoxRenderConfig`.

renderDivider.zh-CN: 自定义清除上下文后的分割线，参数为消息，返回节点。每条分割线调用一次，替换函数时重新调用。
renderDivider.en-US: Renders the divider shown after the context is cleared, with the message, and returns a node. Called once per divider, and again when the function is replaced.

renderHintBox.zh-CN: 自定义提示项的渲染，参数为 `content`、`index` 和 `onHintClick`，返回节点。
renderHintBox.en-US: Renders each hint item with `content`, `index` and `onHintClick`, and returns a node.

renderInputArea.zh-CN: 自定义输入区域，参数为 `defaultNode`、`onSend`、`onClear` 和 `detailProps`，返回节点。`defaultNode` 与 `detailProps` 里的节点是渲染函数，在要放置的位置调用。
renderInputArea.en-US: Renders the input area with `defaultNode`, `onSend`, `onClear` and `detailProps`, and returns a node. `defaultNode` and the nodes in `detailProps` are render functions, called where they are placed.

onMessageSend.zh-CN: 发送消息时触发，参数为文本内容和附件。
onMessageSend.en-US: Called when a message is sent, with the text and the attachments.

onChatsChange.zh-CN: 对话列表变化时触发，参数为新的列表。
onChatsChange.en-US: Called with the new list when the conversation list changes.

onMessageCopy.zh-CN: 复制消息时触发，参数为消息。
onMessageCopy.en-US: Called with the message when it is copied.

onMessageDelete.zh-CN: 删除消息时触发，参数为消息。
onMessageDelete.en-US: Called with the message when it is deleted.

onMessageGoodFeedback.zh-CN: 消息正向反馈时触发，参数为消息。
onMessageGoodFeedback.en-US: Called with the message on positive feedback.

onMessageBadFeedback.zh-CN: 消息负向反馈时触发，参数为消息。
onMessageBadFeedback.en-US: Called with the message on negative feedback.

onMessageReset.zh-CN: 重置消息时触发；由 `resetMessage` 方法触发时参数为 `null`。
onMessageReset.en-US: Called when a message is reset; the argument is `null` when the `resetMessage` method triggers it.

onClear.en-US: Called when the context is cleared.

onHintClick.zh-CN: 点击提示信息时触发，参数为提示文本。
onHintClick.en-US: Called with the hint text when a hint is clicked.

onInputChange.zh-CN: 输入内容或附件变化时触发，参数为 `{ inputValue, attachment }`。
onInputChange.en-US: Called when the input text or the attachments change, with `{ inputValue, attachment }`.

onStopGenerator.zh-CN: 点击停止生成按钮时触发，参数为鼠标事件。
onStopGenerator.en-US: Called with the mouse event when the stop button is clicked.

ref.zh-CN: 根元素，带有下方 Methods 中的方法。
ref.en-US: The root element, which carries the methods listed under Methods.

resetMessage.zh-CN: 将最后一条消息重置为空内容的 loading 状态，并触发 `onMessageReset`，参数为 `null`。
resetMessage.en-US: Resets the last message to an empty loading state and calls `onMessageReset` with `null`.

clearContext.zh-CN: 在对话末尾追加分割线以清除上下文，并触发 `onClear`；末尾已是分割线时无效果。
clearContext.en-US: Clears the context by appending a divider and calls `onClear`; does nothing when the list already ends with a divider.

scrollToBottom.zh-CN: 滚动到最底部，`animation` 为 `true` 时平滑滚动，否则直接跳转。
scrollToBottom.en-US: Scrolls to the bottom; smoothly when `animation` is `true`, otherwise jumps.

sendMessage.zh-CN: 发送消息，不传 `attachment` 时消息的内容为字符串。
sendMessage.en-US: Sends a message; without `attachment` the message content is a string.
